findings.summary: An active Academic or Attendance parent link can look current but lack aria-current whenever its submenu exists and no child link is current.
findings.fix: Suppress aria-current on a parent only when one of its submenu links is current; otherwise set aria-current=page on the active parent.
findings.evidence: The is-current class depends on item.current, but aria-current was suppressed based on submenu presence instead of whether a child was current.

passed: Navigation groups preserve item order, and Academic/Attendance submenu links are ordinary anchors in sequential Tab order.
The skip link is first in document order; links and buttons have visible focus styling.
notes: Static source review only; no browser keyboard scan was run.
